items.hook: Henry Charles Bukowski was a German-American poet, novelist, and short story writer.
items.body: His writing was influenced by the social, cultural, and economic ambience of his adopted home city of Los Angeles. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: The Diddakoi is a 1972 children's novel by Rumer Godden.
items.body: Set in England, it features an orphan traveller or Romani girl, seven-year-old Kizzy Lovell, who faces persecution, grief, and loss in a hostile, close-knit, village community. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: USS Shenandoah, the United States' first American-built rigid airship, was destroyed in a squall line over Noble County, Ohio. Fourteen of her 42-man crew perished, including her commander, Zachary Lansdowne.
items.body: USS Shenandoah was the first of four United States Navy rigid airships. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.
